alkylation reagent: 10 mM iodoacetamide was added and incubated for 30 min in the dark.
alkylation concentration: 10 mM iodoacetamide was added and incubated for 30 min in the dark.
cleavage agent: Proteins were predigested with endoprotease Lys-C (Wako Pure Chemical Industries) with an enzyme/substrate ratio of 1:100 and incubated for 37°C for 4 h.
instrument: Samples were analyzed on a mass spectrometer (Q-Exactive Plus) coupled to an EASY nLC 1000 (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: Quantitative proteomic profiles were obtained from WT and KO total liver lysates using liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry analysis in combination with a spike-in stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) standard.
fragment tolerance: We used 7- and 4.5-ppm tandem mass spectrometry tolerances for the first and main search, respectively.
ptm: N-terminal acetylation (variable); oxidation at methionine residues (variable); carbamidomethylation at cysteine residues (fixed)
N-terminal acetylation and oxidation at methionine residues were defined as variable modifications, whereas carbamidomethylation at cysteine residues was defined as a fixed modification.
reduction reagent: 5 mM DTT was added and incubated at 37°C for 1 h.
reduction concentration: 5 mM DTT was added and incubated at 37°C for 1 h.
